name: grow-shop-nutrient-advisor
title: Nutrient Advisor Bot — NZ Grow Shops
description: Chatbot that recommends nutrients based on crop, growth stage, and setup type. Captures email for follow-up.
flow: Crop selection → tomato, pepper, leafy, herbs, flowers
Growth stage → seedling, veg, flower, harvest
CTA → 'Get your free feeding plan' (email capture)
Follow-up → 3-day email sequence with dosing tips
monetization: Affiliate commission on CATALYX sales + $200/mo retainer from grow shop

name: garden-centre-plant-advisor
title: Plant Advisor Bot — Garden Centres
description: Bot that helps customers choose plants based on location, sun exposure, and skill level.
flow: Sun exposure → full sun, partial, shade
CTA → 'Check availability at our store' (drives foot traffic)
monetization: Drive in-store sales + $150/mo retainer from garden centre

name: trades-website-audit-bot
title: Website Audit Bot — Trades Businesses
description: Bot that offers free website audit for trades businesses. Captures lead, runs audit, sends report.
flow: Auto-audit: check contact page, load speed, mobile-friendliness
Send report with defects + fix recommendations
CTA → 'Book a call to fix it' (upsell)
Follow-up → 7-day email sequence with case studies

name: hydro-shop-product-advisor
title: Hydro Product Advisor Bot — Hydro Shops
description: Bot that recommends hydroponic products based on setup size, budget, and goals.
flow: Setup type → DWC, NFT, drip, soil
monetization: Affiliate commission + $150/mo retainer from hydro shop
